race.comment: NYMPHADORA (8) total forgive first up at Hawkesbury, then relished the fast tempo for a well-deserved victory over 1100m at Goulburn in C2 class. Looks to have more to offer and maps well. CENTIMETRE (9) crunched into favouritism on debut when he sat up on the pace for a game win over 1200m at Goulburn. Gets an even better set-up for this and expected to take the next step.  EPIC (4) defeated inferior opposition first up as the ($1.40 fav) and has raced without luck in the two subsequent runs. Well placed from the rails draw and sure to be thereabouts. LOS PADRES (1) sound return first up after finishing third over 1100m at Hawkesbury in a Mid Bm64. Claim helps again and worth thought.
